limitations: Card colors are assigned via inline CSS custom properties and shuffled randomly; checks cannot predict which cards match, so matched-pair retention and the full win sequence are not verified.
Win message text is fixed in source but reaching the win state requires 8 known matching pairs, which random shuffle makes impossible to plan deterministically.
Mismatch unflip behavior is time-dependent (800ms setTimeout) and cannot be asserted without timing support.
Keyboard accessibility (Enter/Space flipping) relies on trusted browser key events; synthetic DOM key events are not equivalent, so it is not checked.
Visual appearance (colors, card back, matched styling, responsive layout) is not asserted since only text/disabled/visible comparisons are supported.

# Pixel Memory Match

A simple, offline memory match game built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

## Features

- 8 pairs of colored cards (16 cards total)
- Flip two cards at a time; matched pairs stay open
- Move counter
- Win message when all pairs are matched
- New Game button to reset
- Fully keyboard accessible
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or network required.

## Controls

- Click or tap a card to flip it.
- Use Tab to focus cards, Enter or Space to flip.
- Click "New Game" or focus it and press Enter/Space to restart.

## Development

No build step. Edit the files directly.
